facts.listing_identity: 2025 JAVA / 佳沃 FUOCO TOP 105 full-groupset carbon-wheel build
facts.complete_weight_claims: Approximately 8.6-8.9 kg in current manufacturer/seller material; one current public owner or shop measurement reports 9.445 kg
facts.complete_weight_basis: Conflicting exact-trim claims with differing or unstated size, pedal, accessory, and measurement conditions
facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 mechanical 2x12 with R7120 controls, R7100 derailleurs/crank family, 11-34T 12-speed cassette, and R7170 hydraulic disc brakes
facts.frame_material: Toray T700 carbon frame and fork; the current exact trim also uses a carbon cockpit, seatpost, and wheels

source_note: The current JAVA Bikes Chile FUOCO TOP 105-2 page accessed 2026-09-23 corroborates a Toray T700 frame and fork and Shimano 105 R7120/R7100 2x12 hydraulic-disc build. The page warns some components may vary. Complete-weight reports remain materially different, and fitted 700x25C tires do not establish maximum clearance.
